gen-special-elite-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk forms each glyph as a ribbon of constant width with breathing counters, while Special Elite goes distressed and tall. Over a full page it reads smoothly, steady and geometric.
gen-syne-gf-victor-mono: Syne is an experimental display face with an x-height rising near cap height and no pinched curves. But Victor Mono, a monospace with loose spacing, is the structured counterweight to all that experiment.
gen-tourney-gf-aclonica: Wide, bold, athletic: Tourney stretches its single-width strokes and bulky small letters across the line. Then Aclonica adds a deep midsection and a modest thick-thin shift you feel more than see.
gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans reads lightly, with ascenders barely clearing the x-height and a wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart. But Tourney's heading rings out with constant-walled o's, bold and athletic.
gen-tourney-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Bold, athletic and stretched wide: that's Tourney. Alumni Sans Pinstripe tucks its words into tight texture, pairing oversized lowercase with small capitals and rope-thick curves for the strongest tension.
gen-tourney-gf-anaheim: Anaheim is a modern, approachable sans-serif whose rounded forms stay open to the side and whose lowercase fills the line like capitals. But Tourney's flat, single-weight strokes give the heading its athletic bulk.
gen-tourney-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads snug, its x-height nearly reaching the capitals. Tourney cuts bold, athletic strokes with a router bit's fixed width, while Arsenal gently shifts weight along each rounded line.
gen-tourney-gf-days-one: Days One spaces its letters like rungs on a rope ladder, its x-height filling the line, next to Tourney's wide, bold stretch. Up top, marker-nib strokes ignore direction; below, the lines stay quiet.
gen-tourney-gf-farro: Approachable is the word for Farro, with compressed ascenders and strokes that carry no contrast at all. But Tourney owns the loud, stretched-out headline, while Farro keeps the sans-serif text plain.
gen-tourney-gf-inder: Professional is Inder's mood: a clean-lined sans-serif with little height difference between its capitals and lowercase letters. Tourney shouts bold and athletic with unvarying strokes; Inder simply reads on.
